Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Lynbrook

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Lynbrook. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Lynbrook has grown quickly, and we look after everything from the first-generation estate roofs through to the older homes around the township. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Lynbrook: What We Commonly See

Lynbrook is a master-planned estate suburb off the South Gippsland Highway, built largely through the 1990s and 2000s. Those roofs are now old enough that the first round of maintenance and replacement is coming due. Set well inland, they deal with heat, harsh UV and the south-east's hailstorms rather than salt.

The jobs we are called out for most in Lynbrook are refixing cracked ridge capping, storm and hail damage, re-roofing ageing roofs, and replacing tired guttering and downpipes.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Lynbrook

Estate roofs are now old enough that a number of Lynbrook homes are due for a proper look. We re-roof and re-sheet homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, durable and suited to the south-east's hail and UV, and we can match the colour to your existing gutters and trims.

Thinking about going metal? We also handle tile to tin conversions, swapping a heavy, high-maintenance roof for lightweight metal. If your roof has widespread leaks, sagging or badly rusted sheeting, talk to us about a re-roof before you keep paying for patch jobs. We will give you a straight answer on what makes the most sense for your home and budget.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Lynbrook

Newer roofs still need a roof plumber now and then. Our registered roof plumbers reseal and refix flashings, valleys and ridge capping, and sort out undersized downpipes and overflowing gutters, which are the most common problems on estate homes after heavy rain or a storm.

We replace guttering, downpipes and fascia capping in COLORBOND® steel, from a single damaged section through to a complete gutter replacement, and we carry out gutter repairs where a repair is all that is needed. We remove the old guttering cleanly and leave the site tidy.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Lynbrook

Every roof is different, so we quote on what is actually in front of us rather than a one-size-fits-all price. The main things that move the cost are the size and pitch of the roof, the roofing material you choose, how much guttering and flashing is involved, and how easy the roof is to access safely. We will walk you through exactly what your quote covers so there are no surprises.

Our Lynbrook Roofing Process

We start with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. For a re-roof we strip the old roof, prepare the framing, fit insulation and sarking where needed, then re-sheet in new COLORBOND® steel with fresh flashings, ridge capping, gutters and downpipes. We leave the site clean and tidy when we are done.

Why Lynbrook Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, so your job is done to standard and you are covered. As a local, family run business we treat your home the way we would treat our own, turn up when we say we will, and give honest advice rather than a hard sell. Browse the COLORBOND® colour chart to start picturing your new roof.

Lynbrook Roofing FAQs

My roof is fairly new. Do I still need a roof plumber?

Possibly. Newer roofs can still have poorly sealed flashings, undersized downpipes or storm damage. We can inspect the roof, reseal or refix what needs it and give you an honest opinion.

Can you fix hail and storm damage?

Yes. We fix dented sheeting, damaged flashings and storm-related leaks, and can advise whether a re-roof is the better option after major damage.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
